periods.description: The three common Drag-Ride categories used by ordinary Drag-Knights: flight-focused Wyvern, ground/melee-focused Wyrm, and support/special-function Drake.
periods.principles: Each type optimizes a different battlefield role while sharing the same Sword Device summoning and armor-link foundation.
periods.classification: Wyvern: flight; Wyrm: land/melee; Drake: scouting, camouflage, support, repair, and special functions.
levels: reinforced models such as Wyvern X
custom hybrids such as Chimeric Wyvern
periods.origin: Derived from excavated ancient Drag-Rides and adapted by modern users.
limitations: weaker than Divine Drag-Rides in raw performance
each type has obvious role tradeoffs
requires training to exploit or counter
